# developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Docs — Guides — Credit Cards

> 7 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Docs — Guides under Credit Cards. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Credit Cards

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/credit-cards/overview): Credit cards are the most commonly accepted payment method type and are enabled automatically when you sign up for a merchant account with Braintree.
- [Configuration](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/credit-cards/configuration/): There is no additional configuration needed to begin accepting most credit and non-PIN debit card payments.
- [Standard Client-Side Implementation](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/credit-cards/client-side/): Important
- [Advanced Client-Side Implementation](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/credit-cards/client-side-advanced/): Note
- [Server-Side Implementation](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/credit-cards/server-side/): Your integration may be impacted by upcoming certificate changes.
- [Testing and Go Live](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/credit-cards/testing-go-live/): These credit card numbers will not trigger specific credit card errors.
- [Server-Side Implementation](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/credit-cards/server-side/ruby): Your integration may be impacted by upcoming certificate changes.
